description: Three built-in managers do the work here, no custom regex needed:
github-actions -- the four action refs across .github/workflows/*.yml
and .github/actions/setup-waddle-build/action.yml
mise           -- cmake, ninja and xcodegen in mise.toml
xcodegen       -- ZIPFoundation, pinned in App/project.yml
SDL_TAG / OPENAL_TAG / FREEDOOM_VERSION in Scripts/*.sh are NOT covered;
picking them up needs custom regex managers and is a deliberate later
step, not an oversight. WOOF_COMMIT in Scripts/vendor-woof.sh must stay
manual regardless: Engine/woof is a committed tree, so bumping the SHA
without re-running the script leaves the two silently disagreeing.
config:best-practices enables digest pinning, so the first run opens a
'Pin dependencies' PR that SHA-pins every action with a trailing
# vX.Y.Z comment -- that PR is what closes issue #16.
Group all mise-pinned tool updates into one PR. cmake, ninja and
xcodegen are only ever consumed together by a build, and each one
invalidates the same CI caches, so separate PRs would each pay for
a cold build to prove the same thing.
Leave `runs-on: macos-26` alone. Renovate reads it as a
github-runners dep and would offer macos-27 on its own, but the
runner image is pinned in lockstep with XCODE_VERSION /
SIMULATOR_OS, which Renovate cannot see. A runner-only bump lands
on an image that may not ship Xcode 26.2, and setup-waddle-build
hard-fails when the requested Xcode is absent -- so the PR could
never go green on its own. Moving runner images is a coupled,
human decision; drop this rule if that stops being true.
